title: Article 306 — Power of certain States in Part B of the First Schedule to impose restrictions on trade and commerce (Omitted)

content.overview: Article 306 conferred certain powers on States in Part B of the First Schedule regarding restrictions on trade and commerce. It was omitted by the Constitution (Seventh Amendment) Act, 1956 (w.e.f. 1 November 1956) with the abolition of the Part B classification.
content.glance: Art 306 omitted by 7th Amendment 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). Part B trade-restriction power removed.
content.study:
Article 306 was tied to Part B States.

Omission: Constitution (Seventh Amendment) Act, 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956).

Living frame: Trade, commerce and intercourse are governed by Articles 301–305 and related provisions.

Examination rule: Do not cite Article 306 as living law.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What is the status of Article 306?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Article 306 was omitted by the Constitution (Seventh Amendment) Act, 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). It is not living law.
